classes.name: Data Exfiltration
classes.description: Attempts to obtain, expose, extract, or disclose protected or sensitive data.

classes.name: Financial Manipulation
classes.description: Attempts involving unauthorized financial information access, transactions, or financial actions.

classes.name: Code/Tool Manipulation
classes.description: Attempts to manipulate code execution, tool invocation, or agent actions through injected instructions.

classes.name: Instruction Override
classes.description: Attempts to override, subvert, or redirect higher-priority instructions, policies, or intended agent behavior.

classes.name: Physical/Safety Harm
classes.description: Attempts intended to cause physical harm or induce unsafe physical-world actions.

labeling_policy.primary_class: Exactly one primary MAPIS class is assigned when the source evidence supports classification.
labeling_policy.uncertain_samples: Do not force classification. Mark for review.
